bo.ev.auto_escalated: Automatically escalated – no seat at any preference
bo.ev.cluster_reassigned: Moved to another school by cluster office
bo.f.name: Name
bo.force.done: Student registered above capacity – audit entry created
bo.force.text: You hold the force registration permission. Use only in exceptional cases.
bo.force.title: Force registration above capacity
bo.force.warning: This registers the student even if the grade is full. A reason is mandatory and the action is recorded in the audit log.
bo.hol.name: Holiday
bo.hol.note: Lunar holiday dates are approximate and should be confirmed each year.
bo.hol.sub: Working days are Monday to Friday excluding the UAE public holidays below. All deadlines use this calendar.
bo.leavers.release_note: The seat stays held until the leaving date and is then released automatically.
bo.lists.doc_hint: The pathway matrix for document types is edited under Rules & settings › Documents required by pathway.
bo.lists.sub: Values used in drop-downs and rules, in English and Arabic
bo.queue.overdue_hint: Principal and cluster officer are alerted
bo.review.approve_text: The application will be sent to {school}, whose 2-working-day clock starts now.
bo.review.grade_not_offered: This school does not offer the grade
bo.review.info_text: The parent has 5 working days to respond. The 2-working-day decision clock pauses until they respond; with no response the application closes.
bo.review.offer_text: The offer reduces the available seats immediately. The parent has 5 working days to accept.
bo.review.pass_text: No seat at this school: the application moves to the next preference with a seat. If none is left it is escalated to the cluster office.
bo.review.place_text: Placing the child at another cluster school approves the out-of-catchment placement and makes an offer there.
bo.review.seat_lost_text: Another offer for this grade succeeded at the same moment. Only one offer can take the last seat, so this application has moved to its next preference (or to the cluster office if none is left).
bo.review.seat_lost_title: The last seat was just taken
bo.review.sla_note: First decision due by {date} (2 working days).
bo.review.waiting_parent: Waiting for the parent until {date} – decision clock paused
bo.roll.after: Parents can renew for {code} while its renewal window is open ({open} – {close}). They are notified when it opens.
bo.roll.already_run: A roll-over was already run for this year; running it again only adds students not yet placed.
bo.roll.capacity_missing: {n} students are at schools with no capacity set up for this year – set up grades and sections first (Capacity & sections), then run again.
bo.roll.intro: Students enrolled in {source} (or still expected to renew) are carried into {target} at the next grade in the same school, as seats held for renewal. Parents then confirm them in the renewal window. Students who already have a place in {target} are skipped, so this can be run again safely.
bo.roll.new_school: Need a new school (next grade not offered)
bo.roll.over: These grades will be over capacity once the seats are held (capacity alerts will be raised):
bo.roll.result: {n} seats held for renewal. {m} renewal notifications sent (sent only while the renewal window of the admission year is open).
bo.roll.title: Roll over students into {code}
bo.rules.approver.school: No prior approval – the school decides directly
bo.rules.bus.order_warn: A seat cannot be confirmed before it is held – choose a confirmation stage at or after the hold stage.
bo.rules.bus.release_on: Release the seat when the application ends by
bo.rules.elig.catchment_and_grade: Catchment contains the home pin, and the school offers the grade
bo.rules.elig.catchment_or_radius: Catchment contains the home pin, or the school is within a distance of it – and offers the grade
bo.rules.elig.grade_in_cluster: Any school in the cluster that offers the grade
bo.rules.lists_text: Leaving reasons and sub-reasons (BR-13) and the other lists are maintained on the Lists screen.
bo.rules.sub: Business rules from section 5 held as data. Changes apply to new applications immediately, without code changes, and are audited.
bo.set.bus_seat_hold.help: When a bus seat is held and confirmed, and which endings release it.
bo.set.capacity_warning_threshold.help: Alerts are raised at this level and at 100%.
bo.set.decision_sla_working_days: BR-06 First decision after submission (working days)
bo.set.default_emirate: Emirate code used in reference numbers
bo.set.eligible_schools_rule: BR-03 Schools shown to a parent
bo.set.eligible_schools_rule.help: Which schools a parent can choose before the grade check. Schools outside this area can still be requested with cluster approval when no eligible school has a seat.
bo.set.exceptional_transfer_approver: BR-14 Approver of transfers outside the window
bo.set.exceptional_transfer_approver.hel: Who must approve a transfer submitted outside the transfer window before the school receives it.
bo.set.grade_age_rules: BR-01 Grade for new entrants by age
bo.set.grade_age_rules.help: Age on the cut-off date of the admission year decides the entry grade; older children move up one grade per year.
bo.set.info_response_working_days: BR-07 Parent response to an information request (working days)
bo.set.info_response_working_days.help: Clock paused meanwhile; the application closes if there is no response.
bo.set.limited_seat_pct: "Limited" seat status threshold (% of capacity left)
bo.set.max_active_applications_per_child: BR-11 Active applications per child per academic year
bo.set.offer_acceptance_working_days.hel: Otherwise the offer lapses and the seat is released.
bo.set.out_of_catchment_suggestions: Nearest out-of-catchment schools shown when the catchment is full
bo.set.priority_order: BR-05 Priority when applications exceed seats
bo.set.priority_order.help: Applied in this order to rank applications competing for the same grade.
bo.set.transfer_grade_rule.help: For each transfer source, place the child in the next grade after the last completed grade, or by age using the BR-01 age rules.
bo.set.working_weekdays.help: Public holidays are maintained in the working-day calendar.
bo.students.leavers_hint: Leaving requests are confirmed on the Leavers page.
bo.students.name: Name
bo.students.next_help.awaiting: A seat is held for next year until the parent renews in the renewal window.
bo.students.next_help.joining: Accepted a place at this school starting next year (new registration or transfer in).
bo.students.next_help.leaving: The student is leaving the MoE network (see the leaving request).
bo.students.next_help.moving_on: This school does not offer the next grade – the parent needs to apply to another school.
bo.students.next_help.not_returning: The seat for next year was released.
bo.students.next_help.renewed: The parent confirmed the place for next year.
bo.students.next_help.transferring: An application at another school was accepted for next year.
bo.students.no_current_joining: Not enrolled at an MoE school this year – joins in {ay}.
bo.students.no_family: This student has no family account on the portal yet (the family has not signed in with UAE PASS).
bo.students.refine: Refine the search to see the rest.
bo.students.search_ph: Name (English or Arabic) or Emirates ID
bo.students.sub_all: Students enrolled this year in the schools you can see
bo.tpl.sub: Email and in-portal templates for every notification, in English and Arabic
bo.tr.sub: Bus routes, seat requests and waiting lists
bo.tr8.sub: Base texts come from the resource files; overrides made here apply immediately for everyone
bo.users.force_note: Force registration is a separate permission given only to selected Ministry Administrators. Without it the option is not displayed at all.
bo.win.confirm_admission: Make {code} the admission year? New applications and renewals will be for {code}.
bo.win.confirm_delete: Delete academic year {code} with its windows and sections?
bo.win.copy_hint: Copies every school’s grades, sections and maximum per section; adjust them on Capacity & sections.
bo.win.copy_none: Do not copy – set up capacity later
bo.win.hint: Outside the transfer window, transfers are accepted only as exceptional cases, approved as set in rule BR-14.
bo.win.rollover_hint: Annual cycle: add the next academic year (copying grades and sections), roll students over into it, open its renewal window, then make it the admission year.
bo.win.sub: Academic years and the open / close dates of each window
bo.win.windows_default: The new-registration, renewal and transfer windows are created with the usual dates (15 Sep–31 Mar, Oct–Dec, Mar–May) and can be changed below.
bo.win.years_hint: The current year is the running school year (leavers, mid-year capacity). The admission year is the year parents apply and renew for.
